# Structlog Config

> structlog-config: opinionated structlog defaults for development and production. JSON logging, stdlib redirection, context and teeing, pytest failure capture, and optional FastAPI access logs.


2026, Michael Bianco

## Pages in this subsection

- [structlog_config.stdlib_logging](index.html.md): Redirect all stdlib loggers to use the structlog configuration.
